rules.name: Arrays used only for existence checks should be Sets
React props should be read-only
Ternary operators should not be nested
Cognitive Complexity of functions should not be too high
Complex index access patterns should be replaced with ".at()" method
"void" should not be used
Unnecessary imports should be removed
Node.js built-in modules should be imported using the "node:" protocol
Promise.resolve() and Promise.reject() should not be used in async functions or promise callbacks
Multiline blocks should be enclosed in curly braces
Empty blocks should be removed
Imports from the same module should be merged
If statements should not be the only statement in else blocks
Text and background colors should have sufficient contrast
Selectors should not be duplicated
React Context Provider values should have stable identities
Deprecated APIs should not be used
Template literals should not be nested
Optional chaining should be preferred
Deprecated CSS features should not be used
Prefer tag over ARIA role
JSX list components should not use array indexes as key
Fields that are only assigned in the constructor should be "readonly"
Use ".some()" instead of ".filter().length" checks or ".find()" for existence testing
